unresolved.finding: test_rewind only asserts equality of array-name sets and prints numerical discrepancies, so arbitrarily different replay results still pass when the names match.
test_set_arrays writes each array's existing value back without checking any changed value, so a setter that silently does nothing passes.
Both integration loops lack a step limit or progress assertion, so an executestep regression that stops advancing time can hang the suite indefinitely.
Both test classes require data from a separate branches/rewind checkout through a fixed relative path, making the suite dependent on a repository layout beyond the trunk being tested.
Importing the test module requires unused nose and matplotlib packages and enables interactive plotting globally, adding collection failures and side effects unrelated to the tested library.
The replay endpoint times t1a and t1b are recorded but never compared, leaving differing final simulation times without an explicit test failure.
The difference threshold has no finite-value check, so NaN differences fail the greater-than comparison and are not even printed as discrepancies.

The names array constructor mixes character literals of lengths one and two without an explicit constructor type specification, which conforming compilers can reject despite the destination having length slen.
The example says it zeros the first element and labels real and integer cases in reverse, while the implementation assigns the supplied value to the entire selected scalar or array.
setvar has no default branch for unsupported types or ranks, so such metadata produces a printed setting message followed by a silent no-op.

Non-master ranks allocate aa and iaa as 1-by-1 arrays and vvs with two elements but subsequently form full-domain sections of those arrays, violating their bounds even when the receiving routine ignores non-master send data.
xshiftest resets errors before each subsequent datatype/rank variant without reporting the previous count, so its final total includes only the three-dimensional integer checks.
Detected numerical mismatches are only printed and never propagated to a program failure status, allowing an automated run to exit normally after failed checks.
shifttest performs 100 exchanges before checking values, so a defective exchange that needs multiple calls to propagate corner data can pass the test.

Corner sentinels are assigned only when both adjacent neighbors exist, leaving interface endpoints on physical domain boundaries prefilled with correct values and unable to expose missing updates there.
The vector-distribution failure message omits the i-1 offset from its printed expected value, so failures beyond the first element report the wrong expectation.
getrowtest fills every local matrix element with the same process-row value, so it cannot distinguish the requested first versus last row or detect permutations within the returned row.
The three-dimensional shift fixtures encode both varying indices as their sum, so swapping those indices over overlapping ranges preserves expected values and can hide layout errors.
The master copies uninitialized a and ia into aa and iaa before scattertest initializes them, creating undefined reads even though the later scattertest overwrites the copied region.
The executable directory omits the Win32 or x64 component used by xbeachlibrary_test.vfproj, so ordinary configuration names select the wrong build directory.
The script uses cd without /d and does not check whether it succeeded, so a solution on another drive or a missing directory leaves execution in the wrong working directory.
The asynchronous test launch never captures the test process exit status and opens ftnunit.html even after launch or execution failure, potentially presenting a stale report.
The wait loop polls without a delay or timeout and matches every process with the executable name, so an unrelated or hung test process can keep the script spinning indefinitely.
The sole interpolation test evaluates the midpoint of two samples, so an implementation that simply averages the endpoint values would pass without using the requested interpolation coordinate.
